[[RC Strasbourg]] won '''Division 1 season 1978/1979''' of the [[Ligue de Football Professionnel|French Association Football League]] with 56 points.

Promoted from [[Ligue 2|Division 2]], who will play in [[French soccer Division 1 1979/1980|Division 1 season 1979/1980]]
* [[Stade Brest]]:Runner-up, winner of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]] group B
* [[RC Lens]]:Third place, winner of barrages against [[Paris FC]]
* [[FC Gueugnon]]:Champion of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]], winner of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]] group A, will not play in [[French soccer Division 1 1979/1980|Division 1 season 1979/1980]] because of its amateur status.
